query:
SELECT
                        id,
                        layer_id,
                        marker_name,
                        latitude,
                        longitude,
                        detail,
                        update_at
                    FROM marker_info_model
                    WHERE user_id = $1 AND layer_id = $2
                    AND (marker_name LIKE $3 ESCAPE '\' OR detail LIKE $3 ESCAPE '\')
